description.zh: 长度、质量、温度、数据、时间和速度的单位换算 —— 两个方向都能算，边打边出结果
description.en: Unit converter for length, mass, temperature, data, time and speed — both directions, live

help.zh: 答案保留几位数字。做饭、接线，6 位都够用。
help.en: How many digits the answer keeps. 6 is enough for cooking and for wiring a plug.

items.zh: 在上面那行打一个数，答案看下面那行。
items.en: Type a number on the top row and read the answer on the bottom row.

items.zh: 反过来，在下面那行打，上面那行出答案 —— 两个框都活着，没有哪个是只读的。
items.en: Type in the bottom row instead and the top row answers — both fields are live, neither is read-only.

items.zh: ⇅ 按钮把两个单位对调，并把答案搬到上面，好让你接着往回换。
items.en: The ⇅ button swaps the two units and carries the answer up, so you can keep converting back.

items.zh: 长度、质量、温度、数据大小、时间和速度。顶上那排小标签用来切换。
items.en: Length, mass, temperature, data size, time and speed. The chips at the top switch between them.

items.zh: 数据大小按 1024 算（1 KB = 1024 B），跟 Windows 报文件大小的口径一样。
items.en: Data sizes are 1024-based (1 KB = 1024 B), the way Windows reports file sizes.

items.zh: 温度是唯一不是简单乘法的：摄氏、华氏和开尔文之间走绝对值换算。
items.en: Temperature is the one that is not a simple multiplication — Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin convert through absolute values.

items.zh: 答案保留这么多位，多的丢掉，所以 1 米换成英尺显示 3.28084，而不是 3.280839895013123。
items.en: The answer keeps this many digits and drops the rest, so 1 m in feet reads 3.28084 rather than 3.280839895013123.

items.zh: 特别大或特别小的答案会改用科学计数法，不会跑出卡片。
items.en: Very large or very small answers switch to scientific notation instead of running off the card.

items.zh: 上一次的分类和两个单位按组件存，再打开卡片还是同一组换算。
items.en: The last category and the two units are stored per widget, so reopening the card lands on the same conversion.

items.zh: 数字本身不存 —— 一打开就带着一个旧数字的换算器，比空框更糟。
items.en: The number itself is not stored — a converter that reopens with a stale number is worse than an empty box.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：分类、单位下拉和怎么用都跟着界面语言走。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: categories, unit menus and the how-to all follow the interface language.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：六个分类，两个方向都实时算，带对调按钮。
changes.en: First release: six categories, both directions live, swap button.

changes.zh: 记住分类和单位，不记数字。
changes.en: Remembers the category and units, not the number.
